G5463.strongs: to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well
G5463.kjv: farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice
senses: at meeting, hail: [[r:MAT.26.49|Mat 26:49 27:29]], [[r:MRK.15.18|Mrk 15:18]], [[r:LUK.1.28|Luk 1:28]], [[r:JHN.19.3|Jhn 19:3]]; pl., [[r:MAT.28.9|Mat 28:9]]; so χχαίρειν λέγω, to give greeting, II Jn 11; in letters, χαίρειν (sc. λέγει; 81, 1), greeting: [[r:ACT.15.23|Act 15:23 23:26]] [[r:JAS.1.1|Jas 1:1]];
at parting, farewell: [[r:2CO.13.11|2Co 13:11]]; (with) on other occasions, be of good cheer: ἐν κυρίῳ, [[r:PHP.3.1|Php 3:1 4:4]] (cf. συν-χαίρω).† (AS)

G5479.kjv: gladness, X greatly, (X be exceeding) joy(-ful, -fully, -fulness, -ous)

G5456.root: probably akin to [[w:G5316]] through the idea of disclosure
G5456.strongs: a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language
senses: prop., of persons, [[r:MAT.2.18|Mat 2:18]] (LXX), al.; φ. αἴρειν (ἐπαίρειν), [[r:LUK.17.13|Luk 17:13]], [[r:ACT.2.14|Act 2:14]], al.; φ. μεγάλῃ εἰπεῖν (λέγειν, φωνεῖν, etc.), [[r:LUK.8.28|Luk 8:28]], [[r:ACT.7.57|Act 7:57]], [[r:REV.5.12|Rev 5:12]], al.; γίνεται (ἔρχεται) φ. ἐκ τ. οὐρανῶν (ἐξ οὐρανοῦ), [[r:MRK.1.11|Mrk 1:11]], [[r:LUK.3.22|Luk 3:22]], [[r:JHN.12.28|Jhn 12:28]], al. (cf. DCG, ii, 810a; Dalman, Words, 204f.); ἀκούειν φωνήν (-ῆς; see: ἀκούω), [[r:ACT.9.4|Act 9:4]], 7 al.; φ. βοῶντος, [[r:MAT.3.3|Mat 3:3]], [[r:MRK.1.3|Mrk 1:3]], [[r:LUK.3.4|Luk 3:4]], [[r:JHN.1.23|Jhn 1:23]]" (LXX); τ. θεοῦ, [[r:JHN.5.37|Jhn 5:37]], [[r:HEB.3.7|Heb 3:7]], al. By meton., (α) of the speaker, βλέπειν τὴν φ., [[r:REV.1.12|Rev 1:12]]; (β) speech, language ( [[r:GEN.11.1|Gen 11:1]], 4Ma.12:7, al.): [[r:1CO.14.10|1Co 14:10]];

G5495.forms: χείρ, genitive, χειρος (accusative, χεῖραν, [[r:1PE.5.6|1Pe 5:6]] T), ἡ
G5495.root: perhaps from the base of [[w:G5494]] in the sense of its congener the base of [[w:G5490]] (through the idea of hollowness for grasping)
G5495.strongs: the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument)
senses: the hand: [[r:MAT.3.12|Mat 3:12]], [[r:MRK.3.1|Mrk 3:1]], [[r:LUK.6.6|Luk 6:6]], al. mult.; ἡ χ., acting subject, [[r:LUK.22.21|Luk 22:21]]; pl., [[r:ACT.17.25|Act 17:25 20:34]], [[r:1JN.1.1|1Jn 1:1]]; τ. ἔργα τῶν χ., [[r:ACT.7.41|Act 7:41]], [[r:REV.9.20|Rev 9:20]]; ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τ. ἐμῇ χ., [[r:1CO.16.21|1Co 16:21]], [[r:COL.4.18|Col 4:18]], [[r:2TH.3.17|2Th 3:17]]; prepositional phrases, esp. those without art., similar to Heb. constructions (Bl., §32, 4; 40, 9; 46, 9), ἐν χ.; with genitive (Lft., in l.), [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19]]; σὺν χ. ἀγγέλου, [[r:ACT.7.35|Act 7:35]]; διὰ (τῶν) χειρῶν (διὰ χειρός), [[r:MRK.6.2|Mrk 6:2]], [[r:ACT.5.12|Act 5:12 7:25]], al.; ἐπὶ χειρῶν, [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]], [[r:LUK.4.11|Luk 4:11]]; ellipse of χ. (ἡ δεξία, ἀριστερα; Bl., §44, 1), [[r:MAT.6.3|Mat 6:3]], al. By meton., for the power or activity of an individual, [[r:MAT.17.22|Mat 17:22]], [[r:MRK.9.31|Mrk 9:31]], [[r:LUK.9.31|Luk 9:31]], [[r:JHN.10.39|Jhn 10:39]], [[r:ACT.12.11|Act 12:11]], al.; metaphorically, of the activity or power of God: [[r:LUK.1.66|Luk 1:66 23:46]], [[r:JHN.10.29|Jhn 10:29]], [[r:ACT.11.21|Act 11:21 13:11]], al. (AS)

G5457.forms: φῶς (Att.. contr. from φάος; φάω), genitive, φωτός, τό
G5457.root: from an obsolete φάω (to shine or make manifest, especially by rays
G5457.strongs: compare,); luminousness (in the widest application, natural or artificial, abstract or concrete, literal or figurative)
senses: light (opposite to τὸ σκότος, ἡ σκοτία): [[r:MAT.17.2|Mat 17:2]], 5, [[r:JHN.11.9|Jhn 11:9-10]], [[r:2CO.4.6|2Co 4:6]]; ἡλίου, [[r:REV.22.5|Rev 22:5]]; of a lamp, [[r:LUK.8.16|Luk 8:16 11:33]], [[r:JHN.5.35|Jhn 5:35]], [[r:REV.18.23|Rev 18:23]]; of a supernatural heavenly light, [[r:ACT.9.3|Act 9:3 12:7 22:6, 9 22:11 26:13]]; hence, ἄγγελος φωτός, [[r:2CO.11.14|2Co 11:14]]; ὁ κλήρος τ. ἁγίων ἐν τ. φ., [[r:COL.1.12|Col 1:12]]; of the divine glory, [[r:REV.21.24|Rev 21:24]]; by meton., of that which gives light: of fire, [[r:MRK.14.54|Mrk 14:54]], [[r:LUK.22.56|Luk 22:56]] (cl.; [[r:1MA.12.29|1Ma 12:29]]; cf. DCG, i, 595; pl., of a lamp or torch, [[r:ACT.16.29|Act 16:29]]; of heavenly bodies, [[r:JAS.1.17|Jas 1:17.]] Metaphorical,

of spiritual truth and its effects on the lives of men: [[r:MAT.4.16|Mat 4:16 5:16]], [[r:JHN.1.4|Jhn 1:4-5 3:19-21]], [[r:ACT.26.18|Act 26:18, 23]], [[r:2CO.6.14|2Co 6:14]], [[r:EPH.5.13|Eph 5:13]], [[r:1PE.2.9|1Pe 2:9]], [[r:1JN.2.8|1Jn 2:8]]; τ. φ. τ. ζωῆς, [[r:JHN.8.12|Jhn 8:12]]; τ. ὅπλα τοῦ φ., [[r:ROM.13.12|Rom 13:12]]; καρπὸς τοῦ φ., [[r:EPH.5.9|Eph 5:9]]; έν τ. φ. περιπατεῖν (εἶναι, μένειν), [[r:1JN.1.7|1Jn 1:7]] [[r:JHN.2.9|Jn 2:9-10]]; υἱοὶ (τέκνα) τοῦ φ., [[r:LUK.16.8|Luk 16:8]], [[r:JHN.12.36|Jhn 12:36]], [[r:EPH.5.8|Eph 5:8]], [[r:1TH.5.5|1Th 5:5]]; by meton., of one from whom truth shines forth: [[r:ACT.13.47|Act 13:47]] (LXX), [[r:ROM.2.19|Rom 2:19]]; esp. of Christ, [[r:LUK.2.32|Luk 2:32]], [[r:JHN.1.7|Jhn 1:7-8 12:35-36, 46]]; τ. φ. τ. κόσμου, [[r:JHN.8.12|Jhn 8:12 9:5]];τ. φ. τ. ἀληθινόν, [[r:JHN.1.9|Jhn 1:9]]; of Christians, [[r:MAT.5.14|Mat 5:14]], [[r:EPH.5.8|Eph 5:8]]; (with) of the spiritual under­standing: τ. φ. τὸ ἐν σοί, [[r:MAT.6.23|Mat 6:23]], [[r:LUK.11.35|Luk 11:35]];
adverbially, of that which is open to view (opposite to ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ): ἐν τ. φ., [[r:MAT.10.27|Mat 10:27]], [[r:LUK.12.3|Luk 12:3]].† SYN.: see: φέγγος (AS)

(φονεύς), to kill, murder. absol., [[r:MAT.5.21|Mat 5:21]], [[r:JAS.4.2|Jas 4:2]]; μὴ (οὐ) φονεύσῃς (-εις), [[r:MAT.5.21|Mat 5:21 19:18]], [[r:MRK.10.19|Mrk 10:19]], [[r:LUK.18.20|Luk 18:20]], [[r:ROM.13.9|Rom 13:9]], [[r:JAS.2.11|Jas 2:11]] (all from [[r:EXO.20.13|Exo 20:13-14]]); with accusative, [[r:MAT.23.31|Mat 23:31, 35]], [[r:JAS.5.6|Jas 5:6]].† (AS)

G5438.strongs: a guarding or (concretely, guard), the act, the person; figuratively, the place, the condition, or (specially), the time (as a division of day or night), literally or figuratively
senses: actively, a guarding, guard, watch (Hom., Plat., Xen., al.): cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, [[r:LUK.2.8|Luk 2:8]];

of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., sentinels, a guard (Hom., al.): [[r:ACT.12.10|Act 12:10]]; (with) of the place where persons are kept under guard, a prison (Hdt., Thuc., al.): [[r:MAT.14.10|Mat 14:10]], [[r:MRK.6.17|Mrk 6:17]], [[r:LUK.3.20|Luk 3:20]], [[r:ACT.5.19|Act 5:19]], [[r:2CO.6.5|2Co 6:5]], [[r:1PE.3.19|1Pe 3:19]], [[r:REV.18.2|Rev 18:2]], al.;
of the time during which guard was kept by night (Lest. vigilia; Anthol.), a watch: [[r:MAT.14.25|Mat 14:25 24:43]], [[r:MRK.6.48|Mrk 6:48]], [[r:LUK.12.38|Luk 12:38]] (AS)
φωτεινός (WH, φωτινός), ή, όν (φῶς), bright, light: νεφέλη, [[r:MAT.17.5|Mat 17:5]]; opposite to σκοτεινός, [[r:MAT.6.22|Mat 6:22]], [[r:LUK.11.34|Luk 11:34, 36]].† (AS)

G5429.strongs: thoughtful, i.e. sagacious or discreet (implying a cautious character; while denotes practical skill or acumen; and indicates rather intelligence or mental acquirement); in a bad sense conceited (also in the comparative)
senses: (φρονέω), practically wise, sensible, prudent: [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16 24:45]], [[r:LUK.12.42|Luk 12:42]], [[r:1CO.10.15|1Co 10:15]]; opposite to μωρός, [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24 25:2, 4 25:8-9]], [[r:1CO.4.10|1Co 4:10]]; to ἄφρων, [[r:2CO.11.19|2Co 11:19]]; φ. παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ (EV, wise in one's own conceit), [[r:ROM.11.25|Rom 11:25 12:16]] (cf. [[r:PRO.3.7|Pro 3:7]]); compar., -ώτερος, [[r:LUK.16.8|Luk 16:8.]]† SYN.: see: σοψός (AS)

G5467.root: perhaps from [[w:G5465]] through the idea of reducing the strength
G5467.strongs: difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious
senses: hard to do or deal with, difficult;
hard to bear, painful, grievous: καιροί, [[r:2TI.3.1|2Ti 3:1]]; (with) of persons, hard to deal with, harsh, fierce, savage: [[r:MAT.8.28|Mat 8:28.]]† (AS)

G5475.root: perhaps from [[w:G5465]] through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose)
G5475.strongs: copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it)

G5409.strongs: to have a burden, i.e. (by analogy) to wear as clothing or a constant accompaniment
senses: frequent. of φέρω, denoting repeated or habitual action (cf. Tr., Syn., § lviii), most commonly used of clothing, weapons, etc., to bear constantly, wear: [[r:MAT.11.8|Mat 11:8]], [[r:JHN.19.5|Jhn 19:5]], [[r:ROM.13.4|Rom 13:4]], [[r:1CO.15.49|1Co 15:49]], [[r:JAS.2.3|Jas 2:3]].† (AS)

G5412.strongs: to load up (properly, as a vessel or animal), i.e. (figuratively) to overburden with ceremony (or spiritual anxiety)
senses: (φόρτος), to load: with dupl. accusative, [[r:LUK.11.46|Luk 11:46]]; pass., to be laden: metaphorically (EV, heavy laden), [[r:MAT.11.28|Mat 11:28.]]† (AS)

G5413.strongs: an invoice (as part of freight), i.e. (figuratively) a task or service
senses: (dimin. of φόρτος), a burden, load: of the cargo of a ship (Hdt., al.), [[r:ACT.27.10|Act 27:10]]; metaphorically, [[r:MAT.11.30|Mat 11:30 23:4]], [[r:LUK.11.46|Luk 11:46]], [[r:GAL.6.5|Gal 6:5]].† SYN.: βάρος (which see), ὄγκος (AS)

G5401.root: from a primary φέβομαι (to be put in fear)
senses: That which causes flight, fear, dread, terror: [[r:LUK.1.12|Luk 1:12]], [[r:ACT.5.5|Act 5:5]], [[r:1TI.5.20|1Ti 5:20.]] [[r:1JN.4.18|1Jn 4:18]], al.; cogn. accusative, φοβεῖσθαι φ., [[r:MRK.4.41|Mrk 4:41]], [[r:LUK.2.9|Luk 2:9]]; with genitive obj., [[r:JHN.7.13|Jhn 7:13 19:33 20:19]], [[r:HEB.2.5|Heb 2:5]], [[r:1PE.3.14|1Pe 3:14]] (but cf. ICC, in l);ἀπὸ (τοῦ) φ., [[r:MAT.14.26|Mat 14:26]], [[r:LUK.21.26|Luk 21:26]]; εἰς φ., [[r:ROM.8.15|Rom 8:15]]; μετὰ φόβου, [[r:MAT.28.8|Mat 28:8]]; φ. καὶ τρόμος (Lft., Notes, 172), [[r:1CO.2.3|1Co 2:3]], [[r:2CO.7.15|2Co 7:15]], [[r:EPH.6.5|Eph 6:5]], [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]]; by meton., of that which causes fear, [[r:ROM.13.3|Rom 13:3]]; of reverential fear, [[r:ROM.13.7|Rom 13:7]], [[r:1PE.1.17|1Pe 1:17 2:18 3:2 3:15]]; τ. κυρίου, [[r:ACT.9.31|Act 9:31]], [[r:2CO.5.11|2Co 5:11]] (see Field, Notes, 183); Χριστοῦ, [[r:EPH.5.21|Eph 5:21]]; θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.3.18|Rom 3:18]], [[r:2CO.7.1|2Co 7:1]] SYN.: see: δειλία (and of. DCG, i, 381) (AS)

G5491.forms: χεῖλος, -ους, τό, genitive pl., -εων (see Bl., § 8, 4; Thackeray, Gr., I, 151)
G5491.root: from a form of the same as [[w:G5490]]
G5491.strongs: a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water)
senses: a lip (as in Heb., of the lip as the organ of speech): [[r:MAT.15.8|Mat 15:8]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6]], [[r:ROM.3.13|Rom 3:13]], [[r:1CO.14.21|1Co 14:21]], [[r:HEB.13.15|Heb 13:15]], [[r:1PE.3.10|1Pe 3:10]]" (LXX). Metaphorical, of things, an edge, brink, etc. (Hom., Hdt., al.): of the sea­shore, [[r:HEB.11.12|Heb 11:12.]]† (AS)

G5451.strongs: trans-planting, i.e. (concretely) a shrub or vegetable
senses: = φύτευμα, that which is planted, a plant (Inscr.): [[r:MAT.15.13|Mat 15:13.]]† (AS)

G5452.strongs: to set out in the earth, i.e. implant; figuratively, to instil doctrine
senses: (φυτόν, a plant, φύω), to plant: [[r:LUK.17.28|Luk 17:28]], [[r:1CO.3.6|1Co 3:6-8]]; with accusative, φυτείαν, [[r:MAT.15.13|Mat 15:13]]; ἀμπελῶνα, [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33]], [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]], [[r:LUK.20.9|Luk 20:9]], [[r:1CO.9.7|1Co 9:7]]; pass., before ἐν, [[r:LUK.13.6|Luk 13:6 17:6]].† (AS)

G5419.root: probably akin to [[w:G5420]] through the idea of defining
G5419.strongs: to indicate (by word or act), i.e. (specially), to expound
senses: φράζω to show forth, tell, declare, explain: [[r:MAT.13.36|Mat 13:36]] (WH, RV, διασάφησον) [[r:MAT.15.15|Mat 15:15.]]† (AS)

G5408.root: from an obsolete primary φένω (to slay)

G5478.strongs: a Chanaanæan (i.e. Kenaanite), or native of gentile Palestine

G5494.root: from a derivative of χέω (to pour
G5494.strongs: akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e. winter
senses: Prop., a winter storm, hence, generally, a storm, tempest: [[r:MAT.16.3|Mat 16:3]] (T, WH, R, mg., om.), [[r:ACT.27.20|Act 27:20.]]† (AS)

G5426.strongs: to exercise the mind, i.e. entertain or have a sentiment or opinion; by implication, to be (mentally) disposed (more or less earnestly in a certain direction); intensively, to interest oneself in (with concern or obedience)
G5426.kjv: set the affection on, (be) care(-ful), (be like-, + be of one, + be of the same, + let this) mind(-ed), regard, savour, think
senses: to think, to be minded in a certain way: ὡς νήπιος, [[r:1CO.13.11|1Co 13:11]]; with accusative (usually neut., adj., or pron., as frequently in cl.), ὃ δεῖ, [[r:ROM.12.3|Rom 12:3]]; ἃ, [[r:ACT.28.22|Act 28:22]]; τοῦτο, [[r:PHP.3.15|Php 3:15]]; τι ἑτέρως, ib.; οὐδὲν ἄλλο, [[r:GAL.5.10|Gal 5:10]]; τ. αὐτὸ φ. (Deiss., BS, 256), to be of the same mind, [[r:2CO.13.11|2Co 13:11]], [[r:PHP.2.2|Php 2:2 4:2]]; id. before εἰς (ἐν) ἀλλήλους(οις), [[r:ROM.12.16|Rom 12:16 15:5]]; τ. ἓν φ., [[r:PHP.2.2|Php 2:2]] (Lft., in l); before ὑπέρ, [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7.]]

to have in mind, be mindful of, think of (Hdt., Xen., al.; Es, 1Mac, ll. with): τὰ τ. θεοῦ, opposite to τ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[r:MAT.16.23|Mat 16:23]], [[r:MRK.8.33|Mrk 8:33]]; τὰ τ. σαρκός, opposite to τ. τ. πνεύρατος, [[r:ROM.8.5|Rom 8:5]]; τ. ἐπίγεια, [[r:PHP.3.19|Php 3:19]]; τὰ ἄνω, opposite to τ. ἐπὶ τ. γῆς, [[r:COL.3.2|Col 3:2]]; τοῦτο φρονεῖτε (RV, have this mind in you), [[r:PHP.2.5|Php 2:5]]; ὑψηλά, [[r:ROM.12.16|Rom 12:16]]; φ. ἡμέραν (to observe a day), [[r:ROM.14.6|Rom 14:6]]; before ὑπέρ, [[r:PHP.4.10|Php 4:10]] (cf. κατα-, παρα-, περι-, ὑπερ-φρσνέω).† (AS)

G5442.root: probably from [[w:G5443]] through the idea of isolation
G5442.strongs: to watch, i.e. be on guard (literally of figuratively); by implication, to preserve, obey, avoid
senses: to guard or watch: with cogn. accusative, φυλακάς, [[r:LUK.2.8|Luk 2:8]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.12.4|Act 12:4 28:16]]; pass., [[r:LUK.8.29|Luk 8:29]], [[r:ACT.23.35|Act 23:35]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.22.20|Act 22:20]];

to guard or protect: with accusative, [[r:LUK.11.21|Luk 11:21]], [[r:JHN.12.25|Jhn 12:25 17:12]], [[r:2TH.3.3|2Th 3:3]], [[r:1TI.6.20|1Ti 6:20]], [[r:2TI.1.12|2Ti 1:12 1:14]], [[r:2PE.2.5|2Pe 2:5]]; ἑαυτὸν ἀπό, [[r:1JN.5.21|1Jn 5:21]] (Westc., in l); metaphorically of law, precept, etc., to keep, preserve, observe: [[r:MAT.19.20|Mat 19:20]], [[r:LUK.11.28|Luk 11:28 18:21]], [[r:JHN.12.47|Jhn 12:47]], [[r:ACT.7.53|Act 7:53 16:4 21:24]], [[r:ROM.2.26|Rom 2:26]], [[r:GAL.6.13|Gal 6:13]], [[r:1TI.5.21|1Ti 5:21]]. Mid., to be on one's guard (against), keep oneself from, beware of: with accusative, [[r:ACT.21.25|Act 21:25]], [[r:2TI.4.15|2Ti 4:15]]; before ἀπό., [[r:LUK.12.15|Luk 12:15]]; ἵνα μή, [[r:2PE.3.17|2Pe 3:17]]; as in LXX ([[r:EXO.12.17|Exo 12:17]], [[r:LEV.18.4|Lev 18:4]], al.), of laws, etc., to keep, observe: ταῦτα πάντα, [[r:MRK.10.20|Mrk 10:20]] (cf. δια-φυάσσω).† SYN.: τηρέω, q.v (AS)

G5443.strongs: an offshoot, i.e. race or clan
senses: a body of men united by kinship or habitation, a clan or tribe: of the tribes of Israel, [[r:MAT.19.28|Mat 19:28]], [[r:LUK.2.36|Luk 2:36 22:30]], [[r:ACT.13.21|Act 13:21]], [[r:ROM.11.1|Rom 11:1]], [[r:PHP.3.5|Php 3:5]], [[r:HEB.7.13|Heb 7:13-14]], [[r:JAS.1.1|Jas 1:1]], [[r:REV.5.5|Rev 5:5 7:4-8 21:12]]; of the tribes of the earth, the peoples and nations, [[r:MAT.24.30|Mat 24:30]], [[r:REV.1.7|Rev 1:7 5:9 7:9 11:9 13:7 14:6]].† (AS)

G5455.strongs: to emit a sound (animal, human or instrumental); by implication, to address in words or by name, also in imitation
senses: Of persons, to call out, cry out, speak aloud: [[r:LUK.8.8|Luk 8:8]]; φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[r:MRK.1.26|Mrk 1:26]], [[r:ACT.16.28|Act 16:28]]; ἐφώνησε (φωνῇ μεγάλῇ) λέγων, [[r:LUK.8.54|Luk 8:54]], [[r:REV.14.18|Rev 14:18]]; φωνήσαντες ἐπύθοντο, [[r:ACT.10.18|Act 10:18.]]

Of the cries of animals (rarely in cl.; [[r:ISA.38.14|Isa 38:14]], Je, l.with): of a cock, to crow, [[r:MAT.26.34|Mat 26:34]], [[r:MRK.14.30|Mrk 14:30]], [[r:LUK.22.3|Luk 22:3]], [[r:JHN.13.38|Jhn 13:38 18:27]].

Trans. (in cl. chiefly poët.), with accusative of person(s), to call, summon, invite: [[r:MAT.20.32|Mat 20:32 27:47]], [[r:MRK.9.35|Mrk 9:35 10:49 15:35]], [[r:LUK.14.12|Luk 14:12 16:2 19:15]], [[r:JHN.1.49|Jhn 1:49 2:9 4:16 10:3 11:28 12:17 18:33]], [[r:ACT.9.41|Act 9:41 10:7]]; to address, call by name (Soph.), [[r:JHN.13.13|Jhn 13:13]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπι-, προσ-, συν-φωνέω).† (AS)

G5418.strongs: a fence, or inclosing barrier (literally or figuratively)
senses: = φράγμα, a fence: [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33]], [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]], [[r:LUK.14.23|Luk 14:23]]. Metaphorical, μεσότοιχον (which see) τοῦ φ., genitive epexeg., [[r:EPH.2.14|Eph 2:14]] (see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

G5406.strongs: a murderer (always of criminal (or at least intentional) homicide; which does not necessarily imply; while is a special term for a public bandit)

G5440.strongs: a guard-case, i.e. "phylactery" for wearing slips of Scripture texts
senses: an amulet (Plut., al.); in NT for the Talmudic תְּפִלִּין, a prayer fillet, a phylactery, a small strip of parchment on which portions of the law were written and worn on the forehead and next the heart (cf. [[r:EXO.13.16|Exo 13:16]]): [[r:MAT.23.5|Mat 23:5]].† (AS)

G5417.root: from a presumed equivalent of the Latin flagellum
G5417.strongs: to whip, i.e. lash as a public punishment

senses: to let loose, let go; (with) to lower, let down: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.2.4|Mrk 2:4]], [[r:LUK.5.4|Luk 5:4-5]], [[r:ACT.9.25|Act 9:25 27:17, 30]]; with accusative of person(s) (cf. Je, l.with), pass., [[r:2CO.11.33|2Co 11:33.]]† (AS)

χειρο-ποίητος, -ον (χείρ, ποιέω), made by hand (i.e. of human handiwork): of temples, [[r:MRK.14.58|Mrk 14:58]], [[r:ACT.7.48|Act 7:48 17:24]], [[r:HEB.9.11|Heb 9:11, 24]]; of circumcision, [[r:EPH.2.11|Eph 2:11.]]† (AS)

G5428.strongs: mental action or activity, i.e. intellectual or moral insight
senses: (φρονέω), understanding, practical wisdom, prudence: [[r:LUK.1.17|Luk 1:17]], [[r:EPH.1.8|Eph 1:8]].† SYN.: see: σοφία, and cf. Lft., Notes, 317 (AS)

G5487.strongs: to grace, i.e. indue with special honor
senses: (χάρις), to endow with χάρις (which see), i.e.
In Hellenistic writings (for exx., see AR, Eph., 227; Lft., Notes, 315),

G5485.strongs: graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the life; including gratitude)
G5485.kjv: acceptable, benefit, favour, gift, grace(- ious), joy, liberality, pleasure, thank(-s, -worthy)
senses: χάρις, -ιτος, ἡ Abbott-Smith does not include the article here., accusative, χάριν (χάριτα in [[r:ACT.24.27|Act 24:27]], Ju 4; see WH, App., 157),

objectively, that which causes favourable regard, gracefulness, grace, loveliness of form, graciousness of speech (cl.; [[r:ECC.10.12|Ecc 10:12]], [[r:SIR.21.16|Sir 21:16]], al.): [[r:COL.4.6|Col 4:6]]; λόγοι τ. χάριτος (genitive qual.), [[r:LUK.4.22|Luk 4:22.]]

on the part of the giver, grace, graciousness, kindness, goodwill, favour: [[r:LUK.2.52|Luk 2:52]], [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10]], al.; esp. in NT of the divine favour, grace, with emphasis on its freeness and universality: [[r:LUK.1.30|Luk 1:30]], [[r:ACT.14.26|Act 14:26]], [[r:ROM.1.7|Rom 1:7]], [[r:1CO.1.3|1Co 1:3]], al.; opposite to ὀφείλημα, [[r:ROM.4.4|Rom 4:4, 16]]; to ἔργα, [[r:ROM.11.6|Rom 11:6]];
on the part of the receiver, a sense of favour received, thanks, gratitude: [[r:ROM.6.17|Rom 6:17 7:25]], al.; χ. ἔχειν, to be thankful, [[r:LUK.17.9|Luk 17:9]], [[r:1TI.1.12|1Ti 1:12]], al.
Objectively, of the effect of grace,

a proof or gift of grace (cl., a favour): [[r:JHN.1.16|Jhn 1:16]], [[r:ACT.6.8|Act 6:8]], [[r:ROM.1.5|Rom 1:5]], [[r:1CO.3.10|1Co 3:10]], [[r:2CO.9.8|2Co 9:8]], [[r:GAL.2.9|Gal 2:9]], [[r:EPH.3.2|Eph 3:2]], [[r:1PE.5.5|1Pe 5:5, 10]] al. (For fuller treatment of the NT usage, see AR, Eph., 221ff.; DB, ii, 254ff.; DCG, i, 686ff.; Cremer, see word). (AS)

G5483.strongs: to grant as a favor, i.e. gratuitously, in kindness, pardon or rescue
senses: to show favour or kindness: with dative of person(s), [[r:GAL.3.18|Gal 3:18.]]

to give freely, bestow: with accusative and dative, [[r:LUK.7.21|Luk 7:21]], [[r:ACT.3.14|Act 3:14 25:11, 16 27:24]], [[r:ROM.8.32|Rom 8:32]], [[r:1CO.2.12|1Co 2:12]], [[r:PHP.1.29|Php 1:29 2:9]], Phm 22.

In late Gk. (= Lat. condonare), to grant forgiveness, forgive freely: of debt, [[r:LUK.7.42|Luk 7:42-43]] (EGT, in l); of sin, [[r:2CO.2.7|2Co 2:7 2:10 12:13]], [[r:EPH.4.32|Eph 4:32]], [[r:COL.2.13|Col 2:13 3:13]] (cf. DB, ii, 57a).† (AS)

G5484.strongs: through favor of, i.e. on account of
G5484.kjv: be-(for) cause of, for sake of, +…fore, X reproachfully
senses: therefore, because of this, for this reason the acc. sg form of the noun χάριν which can be used as an improper preposition, on account of, because of, for this reason [[r:LUK.7.47|Lk 7:47]]; [[r:EPH.3.1|Eph 3:1, 14]]; [[r:1JN.3.12|1Jn 3:12]]; for the sake of, in order to, [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19]]; [[r:TIT.1.5|Tit 1:5, 11]]; Jude 16; on the score of, [[r:1TI.5.14|1Tim 5:14]]*

G5453.strongs: probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e. to swell up; but only used in the implied sense, to germinate or grow (sprout, produce), literally or figuratively
senses: trans., to bring forth, produce (of men, to beget); pass., to spring up, grow: [[r:LUK.8.6|Luk 8:6]], 8.
Intrans., in 2 aor., pf., plpf., and rarely in present (see LS, see word, A, II.), to spring up: [[r:HEB.12.15|Heb 12:15.]]† (AS)

G5461.strongs: to shed rays, i.e. to shine or (transitively) to brighten up (literally or figuratively)
G5461.kjv: enlighten, illuminate, (bring to, give) light, make to see
senses: intrans., to shine, give light (Arist., Plut., a1.): before ἐπί, [[r:REV.22.5|Rev 22:5.]]

to illumine, enlighten (Diod., Plut., al.): with accusative, [[r:LUK.11.36|Luk 11:36]], [[r:REV.21.23|Rev 21:23]]; pass., [[r:REV.18.1|Rev 18:1.]] Metaphorical, of spiritual enlightenment ([[r:PSA.119.130|Psa 119:130]], [[r:SIR.45.17|Sir 45:17]], al.): [[r:JHN.1.9|Jhn 1:9]], [[r:EPH.1.18|Eph 1:18 3:9]], R, txt., [[r:HEB.6.4|Heb 6:4 10:32]];
to bring to light, make known (Polyb.): [[r:1CO.4.5|1Co 4:5]], [[r:EPH.3.9|Eph 3:9]], R, mg., [[r:2TI.1.10|2Ti 1:10]] (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 107 f.).† (AS)

G5421.strongs: a hole in the ground (dug for obtaining or holding water or other purposes), i.e. a cistern or well; figuratively, an abyss (as a prison)

G5490.root: from a form of an obsolete primary χάω (to "gape" or "yawn")

G5482.root: from χαράσσω (to sharpen to a point
G5482.strongs: akin to through the idea of scratching); a stake, i.e. (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege)

G5411.strongs: a load (as borne), i.e. (figuratively) a tax (properly, an individual assessment on persons or property; whereas is usually a general toll on goods or travel)
senses: (φέρω), tribute paid by a subject nation (cf. [[r:1MA.10.33|1Ma 10:33]]): φ. δοῦναι ([[r:1MA.8.4|1Ma 8:4]] [[r:1MAC.8.7|1Mac 8:7]]), [[r:LUK.20.22|Luk 20:22 23:2]]; ἀποδοῦναι, [[r:ROM.13.7|Rom 13:7]]; τελεῖν, [[r:ROM.13.6|Rom 13:6]] (Hdt., al.).† SYN.: κῆνσος, τέλος (which see) (AS)

G5400.strongs: a frightening thing, i.e. terrific portent
senses: (φοβέω), that which causes fright, a terror: pl. (as always, exc.Isa, l.with), [[r:LUK.21.11|Luk 21:11]] (Hipp., Plat.).† (AS)

G5416.root: neuter of a derivative from the base of [[w:G5417]]
G5416.strongs: a whip, i.e. Roman lash as a public punishment

G5476.root: adverb perhaps from the base of [[w:G5490]] through the idea of a fissure in the soil

senses: Φοῖνιξ (on the accent, see Bl., § 4, 2; WM, § 6, lc), -ικος, ὁ, the date palm, palm: τὰ βαΐα τῶν φ., [[r:JHN.12.13|Jhn 12:13]]; of palm branches, φοίνικες (as Arist., [[r:2MA.10.7|2Ma 10:7]], al.), [[r:REV.7.9|Rev 7:9]].† (AS)
χείμμαρος (shortened form of the more usual -οος, Attic contr., -ους), -ον (χεῖμα, ῥέω) winter-flowing; as subst., ὁ χ. (sc. ποταμός), a torrent: [[r:JHN.18.1|Jhn 18:1.]]† (AS)

G5435.strongs: Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor
senses: φρυγία, -ας, ἡ (prop., the adj., Φρυγίος, -α, -ον; sc. γῆ, χώρα), Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor: [[r:ACT.2.10|Act 2:10]]; Φ. καὶ Γαλατικὴ χώρα (Γ. χ. κ. Φ.), [[r:ACT.16.6|Act 16:6 18:23]] (on these phrases see DB, i, 89 f.; CGT, Gal., xxii f.).† (AS)

G5433.strongs: to snort (as a spirited horse), i.e. (figuratively) to make a tumult
senses: φρυάσσω (so Ps, l.with, NT; elsewhere depon., φρυάσσομαι, Att.. -ττ-), prop., of horses, to neigh, whinny and prance (Plut., al.). Metaphorical, to be wanton, insolent: [[r:ACT.4.25|Act 4:25]] (LXX).† (AS)

G5488.strongs: Charrhan (i.e. Charan), a place in Mesopotamia
senses: χαρράν indecl. (in FlJ., Ant., i, 16, 1, Κάρρα, -ας, ib. 6, 5, Χαρρά, -ᾶς; so LXX: [[r:GEN.29.4|Gen 29:4]] E, [[r:EZK.27.28|Eze 27:28]] B, elsewhere -άν­Heb. חָרָן), Haran, a town in N.W. Mesopotamia: [[r:ACT.7.2|Act 7:2]], 4.† (AS)

G5466.strongs: a Chaldæan (i.e. Kasdi), or native or the region of the lower Euphrates

G5477.strongs: Chanaan (i.e. Kenaan), the early name of Palestine

G5496.strongs: to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person)

G5403.strongs: palm-country; Phœnice (or Phœnicia), a region of Palestine

G5497.root: from [[w:G5495]] and a reduplicated form of [[w:G0071]]
G5497.strongs: a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person)
G5497.kjv: some to lead by the hand
senses: χειρ-αγωγός, -όν (χείρ, ἄγω) leading by the hand. As subst., ὁ χ., one to lead by the head, a guide: [[r:ACT.13.11|Act 13:11.]]† (AS)

G5480.strongs: a scratch or etching, i.e. stamp (as a badge of servitude), or scupltured figure (statue)

senses: φοῖνιξ, -ικος, ο, ἡ Phænix, a city of Crete: [[r:ACT.27.12|Act 27:12.]]† (AS)

G5492.strongs: to storm, i.e. (passively) to labor under a gale
senses: to expose to winter cold, go into winter quarters.
to drive with storm; pass., to be driven with storm, tempest-tossed: [[r:ACT.27.18|Act 27:18.]]† (AS)

G5434.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of φρύγω (to roast or parch
G5434.strongs: akin to the base of); something desiccated, i.e. a dry twig

G5410.strongs: a forum or market-place; only in comparative with; a station on the Appian road
senses: φόρον, -ου, τό (Lat. forum): Ἀππίου Φ., see: Ἄππιος (AS)

G5486.strongs: a (divine) gratuity, i.e. deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e. (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty
senses: (χαρίζομαι) a gift of grace, a free gift, esp. of extra­ordinary operations of the Spirit in the Apostolic Church, but including all spiritual graces and endowments (Lft., Notes, 148 f.): [[r:ROM.1.11|Rom 1:11 5:15-16 6:23 11:29 12:6]], [[r:1CO.1.7|1Co 1:7 7:7 12:4 12:9 12:28 12:30-31]], [[r:2CO.1.11|2Co 1:11]], [[r:1TI.4.14|1Ti 4:14]], [[r:2TI.1.6|2Ti 1:6]], [[r:1PE.4.10|1Pe 4:10]].† (AS)

according to nature (Arist., Diod., al.): opposite to παρὰ φύσιν, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26-27]]; (with) governed by mere natural instinct (of. Plut., Mor., 706 A): ζῷα γεγεννημένα φ. (RV, born mere animals; Mayor, born creatures of instinct; ICC, animals born of mere nature), [[r:2PE.2.12|2Pe 2:12]],† (AS)

G5449.strongs: growth (by germination or expansion), i.e. (by implication) natural production (lineal descent); by extension, a genus or sort; figuratively, native disposition, constitution or usage
senses: the nature (natural powers or constitution) of a person or thing: [[r:JAS.3.7|Jas 3:7]], [[r:2PE.1.4|2Pe 1:4]]; τέκνα φυσει ὀργῆς, [[r:EPH.2.3|Eph 2:3]];

origin, birth (Soph., Xen., al.): [[r:ROM.2.27|Rom 2:27]], [[r:GAL.2.15|Gal 2:15]]; (with) nature, i.e. the regular order or law of nature: [[r:1CO.11.14|1Co 11:14]]; dative, φύσει adverbially, by nature, [[r:ROM.2.14|Rom 2:14]], [[r:GAL.4.8|Gal 4:8]]; παρὰ φύσιν, against nature, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26 11:24]]; καρὰ φ., according to nature, naturally, [[r:ROM.11.21|Rom 11:21, 24]].† (AS)

G5420.root: apparently a strengthening form of the base of [[w:G5424]]
G5420.strongs: to fence or inclose, i.e. (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence)
senses: φράσσω to fence in, stop, close: στόματα λεόντων, [[r:HEB.11.33|Heb 11:33]]; στόμα, metaphorically, [[r:ROM.3.19|Rom 3:19]]; pass., καύχησις, [[r:2CO.11.10|2Co 11:10.]]† (AS)
(φρονέω), that which is in the mind (the content of φρονεῖν, ICC, Ro., 88), the thought: [[r:ROM.8.6|Rom 8:6-7, 27]].† (AS)

G5445.root: from a prolonged form of φύρω (to mix a liquid with a solid
G5445.strongs: perhaps akin to through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough
senses: (φυράω, to mix), that which is mixed or kneaded, a lump: of dough, [[r:ROM.11.16|Rom 11:16]], [[r:1CO.5.6|1Co 5:6-7]], [[r:GAL.5.9|Gal 5:9]]; of clay, [[r:ROM.9.21|Rom 9:21.]]† (AS)

G5402.strongs: probably akin to the base of); Phœbe, a Christian woman

G5448.root: from [[w:G5449]] in the primary sense of blowing
senses: (φῦσα, bellows), = cl. φυσάω, to puff or blow up, inflate. Metaphorical, to puff up, make proud: [[r:1CO.8.1|1Co 8:1.]] Pass., to be puffed up with pride: [[r:1CO.4.18|1Co 4:18-19 5:2 13:4]]; before ὑπό, [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18]]; before ὑπὲρ... κατά, [[r:1CO.4.6|1Co 4:6]] (on the form of the subjc., see M, Pr., 54; Bl., § 22, 3).† (AS)

G5424.root: probably from an obsolete φράω (to rein in or curb; compare [[w:G5420]])
G5424.strongs: the midrif (as a partition of the body), i.e. (figuratively and by implication, of sympathy) the feelings (or sensitive nature; by extension (also in the plural) the mind or cognitive faculties)
senses: φρήν genitive, φρενός, ἡ, chiefly in Hom. and Trag., but also in Plat., al., both sing. and pl.;
in physical sense, the parts about the heart, midriff.
φορτούνατος (Rec. Φουρ-, see Mayser, 116 f.), -ου, ὁ (Lat.) Fortunatus: [[r:1CO.16.17|1Co 16:17]] (see Lft., Cl. Ro., 1Co., 59).† (AS)

G5432.strongs: to be a watcher in advance, i.e. to mount guard as a sentinel (post spies at gates); figuratively, to hem in, protect
senses: (φρουρός, a guard), to guard, keep under guard, protect or keep by guarding: [[r:2CO.11.32|2Co 11:32]]; metaphorically, [[r:GAL.3.23|Gal 3:23]], [[r:PHP.4.7|Php 4:7]], [[r:1PE.1.5|1Pe 1:5]].† (AS)
(φυσιόω), a puffing up, swelling with pride: pl., [[r:2CO.12.20|2Co 12:20.]]† (AS)

G5422.strongs: to be a mind-misleader, i.e. delude
senses: φρεν-απατάω, -ῶ (φρεναπάτης), to deceive one's mind (Lft., deceive by fancies, see Ga., l.with): with accusative of person(s), [[r:GAL.6.3|Gal 6:3.]]† (AS)

G5458.strongs: an illuminator, i.e. (concretely) a luminary, or (abstractly) brilliancy

G5498.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G5495]] and [[w:G1125]]
G5498.strongs: something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e. a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively))
senses: (χείρ, γράφω), written with the hand. As subst., τὸ χ., a handwriting (Inscr., Polyb., al.): metaphorically, [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14.]]† (AS)
(χαλκός), a worker, in metal, esp. a copper-smith: [[r:2TI.4.14|2Ti 4:14.]]† (AS)
(φρήν, ἀπάτη), a deceiver (B1., deceiver of his own mind, § 28, 5.2, where see ref. to π.): [[r:TIT.1.10|Tit 1:10]] (eccl.).† (AS)

G5431.strongs: to exercise thought, i.e. be anxious
senses: (φροντίς, thought), to give heed, take thought (in cl. usually absol., with accusative, with genitive), with inf., [[r:TIT.3.8|Tit 3:8]] (see Bl., § 69, 4; M, Pr., 206 f.).† (AS)

G5481.strongs: a graver (the tool or the person), i.e. (by implication) engraving (("character"), the figure stamped, i.e. an exact copy or (figuratively) representation)
senses: a stamp or impress: as on a coin or seal; metaphorically, χ. τ. ὑποστάσεως, [[r:HEB.1.3|Heb 1:3.]]† (AS)

G5468.root: from a compound of [[w:G5469]] and the reduplicated form of [[w:G0071]]
G5468.strongs: to be a bit-leader, i.e. to curb (figuratively)
senses: (χαλινός, ἄγω), to lead with a bridle; metaphorically, to bridle, restrain: with accusative, γλῶσσαν, [[r:JAS.1.26|Jas 1:26]]; σῶμα, [[r:JAS.3.2|Jas 3:2.]]† (AS)
to shiver, shudder, tremble, from fear: [[r:JAS.2.19|Jas 2:19]] (see Hort, in l).† (AS)

G5469.strongs: a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit)

senses: φωσ-φόρος, -ον (φῶς, φέρω), light-bringing; as subst., ὁ φ., the morning star (Plat., al.; cf. ἐωσφόρος, [[r:ISA.14.12|Isa 14:12]], [[r:JOB.3.9|Job 3:9]], [[r:PSA.110.3|Psa 110:3]]): metaphorically, [[r:2PE.1.19|2Pe 1:19]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

G5489.strongs: a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over)
senses: a sheet of paper, made of papyrus strips (see Kennedy, Sources, 42; Milligan, NTD, 10-12; DB, iv, 945 f.): II Jn 12 (Plat., Inscr.).† (AS)

G5474.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G5475]] and [[w:G3030]] (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy)
G5474.strongs: burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre
senses: χαλκο-λίβανον, -ου, τό chalcolibanus, probably "a mixed metal of great brilliance" (Swete): [[r:REV.1.15|Rev 1:15 2:18]] (RV, burnished brass).† (AS)
chalcedony, "supposed to denote a green silicate of copper found in the mines near Chalcedon " (Swete): [[r:REV.21.19|Rev 21:19.]]† (AS)
